title: Terramity Black Matter Ore Fix With Amplified Nether
description: This data pack fixes generation of Black Matter Ore from Terramity mod with Amplified Nether
body:
This data pack fixes the bug that Black Matter Ore from Terramity mod doesn't generate with Amplified Nether

 

Subscribe on creator's platforms:

Discord Server

YouTube

Telegram channel

Wiki

VK (Russian) 

Notes:
- Terramity also have a bug that Black Matter Ore doesn't generate in biomes from another mods. This data pack doesn't fix that. Look for Black Matter Ore in vanilla biomes
- Terramity also have a bug that Chthonic Cathedral doesn't generate with Amplified Nether. This data pack doesn't fix that but it can be fixed with other mods or data packs that increases Nether building height. This for example: Amplified Nether Height
